desc:
⚔️ ANIME MANIA REMASTERED ⚔️
Summon legendary anime heroes, build your ultimate squad, and battle through iconic arenas!

🌟 FEATURES
💎 Summon and collect your favorite anime characters
⚔️ Fight solo or team up with friends
🚀 Evolve your squad to unstoppable power
🏟️ Battle across iconic anime arenas

🎁 NEXT CODE AT 3K LIKES!
Like and favorite so you never miss a code!

🎮 PC CONTROLS
• Left Click: Basic Attack
• Right Click: Heavy Attack
• 1, 2, 3, 4: Character Skills
• Jump + Left Click: Up Combo
• Left Click in Air: Air Finisher (or use a move)

Inspired by Ani Blox Legends and All Star Tower Defense.

👑 Owners: 123imnotmomo, Yakrus
🏗️ Builders: jacobman737, Lightman373, F33NY
🎬 Animators: lazarovip02
🤝 Contributors: too many to count, thank you all!
